constraint.statement: Part A (offset curvature / EDR3 baseline) is a scale, not a bound: a static radio-optical offset produces no proper motion, a varying centroid can produce proper motion unrelated to the net offset, and the noise of the offset curvature is kept. Its Q exceeds the observed spin6 Q for every clip, so it cannot constrain frame leakage; only Part B constrains a G/BP-RP-dependent frame.

A_icrf3_minus_gaia.scope: Static radio-optical offsets do not move; the PM-equivalent numbers assume the whole shell-wise offset pattern built up linearly over the EDR3 baseline. They are a scale for a centroid-drift leak, not a bound (see constraint). ICRF3 positions are at epoch 2015.0 and Gaia DR3 at 2016.0; quasar PMs are not propagated (the 1 yr difference times the ~5 microarcsec/yr secular-aberration glide is below the offset noise).

bound_draws.scope: Cell frames drawn from N(complement fit, complement fit covariance); the noise-only row draws N(0, same covariance) and shows how much of the leak is fit noise.

leak_quaia_in_sample_cell_frames_diagnos.label: Quaia (G,BP-RP) cell frames ignoring z (in-sample degeneracy diagnostic)

assumptions: (A) ICRF3 S/X matched to Gaia DR3 within 100 mas, unique nearest neighbour; combined covariance ICRF3 + Gaia; R106 shells from Quaia redshifts of the matched sources; PM equivalent = offset curvature / EDR3 baseline (a scale, not a bound; Part A is non-constraining when its Q exceeds the observed Q).

(B) a Gaia frame systematic that depends on G and BP-RP only, measured on the disjoint CRF3 complement in the 16 R106 (G quartile x BP-RP quartile) cells, transfers to Quaia sources of the same cell; frame variation inside a cell, position dependence beyond the 16 VSH terms and redshift dependence at fixed (G, BP-RP) are not covered.

claim_class.A_icrf3_minus_gaia: NUMERICAL scale only (non-constraining when its Q exceeds the observed spin6 Q; see A_icrf3_minus_gaia.constraint)
claim_class.B_crf3_agn_pm_frames: CONDITIONAL on a Gaia frame systematic that depends on G and BP-RP only, measured on the disjoint R106-quality CRF3 complement in the 16 R106 (G, BP-RP) quartile cells and transferred to Quaia sources of the same cell; frame variation inside a cell, position dependence beyond 16 VSH terms and redshift dependence at fixed (G, BP-RP) are not covered; Gaussian cell-fit draws
claim_class.label: CONDITIONAL
claim_class.not_claimed: no calibrated p, no physical Pi/G_F, no Bianchi family identification, no physical attribution

constraint_summary.B_crf3_agn_pm_frames: CONDITIONAL: spin6 leak Q from Gaussian cell-frame draws (bound_draws) versus observed_spin6_Q_jk1

d10_vs_pinned_crf3_fits.reason: D10 (agn_cross_id x gaia_source) not acquired: the anonymous ESA async limit (60 s) aborted the single job and, after bisection, a source_id range in a dense region; part B uses the R106-pinned CRF3 FITS (gaia_crf3_xm x gaia_source, 1,614,173 rows) instead

units.A: offsets mas; VSH coefficients microarcsec; curvature microarcsec per z^2; PM equivalent microarcsec/yr per z^2
units.B: VSH coefficients microarcsec/yr; curvature microarcsec/yr per z^2; Q dimensionless
